Synopsis:
A Canadian woman (Claire Z.) arrested last month on espionage charges while interning at NATO's SHAPE headquarters in Mons, Belgium, has had her pretrial detention extended by one month per Belgian Chamber of Indictments ruling. She is suspected of spying for a third country and membership in a criminal organisation. The case remains in early judicial proceedings with no named state actor identified publicly.
